audit.whatIsWrong: The difficulty fields disagree with each other: diff is HARD and diffRating 7.5/10, but the final rating line reads 'Tricky matchup'. At a 46.6% win rate over 970 games the HARD label is the correct one, so the summary line is the field that is wrong.
audit.why: The rating card and the difficulty badge render on the same page and currently give two different verdicts on the same lane.
audit.corrected: report[14].t changed to 'Hard matchup'. The level chart itself is coherent (Riven 4 / Skill 2 / K'Sante 1, with your one row at level 6) and full and content agree row for row, so no chart flip is proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row is called your one clean window without the number that makes it temporary: Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s against All Out's 120/100/80. By rank 3 her ultimate is back in 60 seconds while yours takes 80.
audit.why: That gap is why level 6 is a window and not a takeover — she gets a Wind Slash cycle you cannot match, which is exactly why the page's 2+ items row goes back to her.
audit.corrected: Added to the late paragraph: her R is 60s at rank 3 against your 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W-charge unstoppable through her W stun' and 'W's unstoppable damage-reduction charge' appear three times. Riot's text for Path Maker is 'charges up, taking reduced damage' — the damage reduction is real, unstoppable is not in the kit, and Ki Burst is a stun that will interrupt the charge. Also 'Q3 knock-up' twice: Ntofo Strikes slows and pulls at two stacks. Riven's own knock-back is the third Broken Wings cast, which the page describes correctly.
audit.why: The advice built on it — charge W into her stun and expect to power through — is the single line most likely to lose a player the trade in a lane they are already losing at 46.6%.
audit.corrected: Path Maker's charge reduces damage taken and stuns on release; it does not ignore Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s, 260 range). Broken Wings is a 13s three-cast chain whose third hit knocks back. Valor (E) is a 10/9/8/7/6s dash that blocks incoming damage — that shield-dash cooldown, not her stun, is the window to commit into. Ntofo Strikes pulls at two stacks.

audit.why: The page already points at the right window — 'track when her E shield is down' — and it is now backed by the number: Valor is 10s at rank 1 and only 6s at rank 5, which is why the 4-5 stage belongs to her.

edits.before: At 3 your Q-W is online — bait her Q dashes and E, then W-charge through her stun and Q3 knock-up to even the trade.
edits.after: At 3 your kit is online — bait her Q dashes and E, then charge W and pull her with a second Q to even the trade.

edits.before: All Out lets you survive her full Q-E-W burst and turn duelist — R through her, W-charge unstoppable, and win the one clean 1v1.
edits.after: All Out lets you survive her Q-E-W burst and turn duelist — R her through a wall, then charge W and win the one clean 1v1.

edits.before: Your Q-W comes online: bait her Q-Q-Q animation, then W-charge unstoppable through her W stun and Q3 knock-up to flip the trade.
edits.after: Your combo comes online: bait the third Broken Wings cast, then charge W through the trade and pull her with a second Q.

edits.before: Riven owns the first two levels: her Q triple-dash and W stun give her a real all-in before you have anything but Q, so don't walk up to last-hit into her combo range — take cs with the edge of Q and eat a little poke. The lane equalizes at 3 when your full Q-W is online. The trick is patience: bait her to throw her Q dashes and E shield first, because once those are on cooldown she has no mobility, and that's when you W-charge into her and land Q3's knock-up.
edits.after: Riven owns the first two levels: her Broken Wings triple-cast and Ki Burst stun give her a real all-in before you have anything but Q, so don't walk up to last-hit into her combo range — take cs with the edge of Q and eat a little poke. The lane equalizes at 3 when your full kit is online. The trick is patience: bait out her Q dashes and her 10s E shield, because once those are down she has no mobility, and that is when you charge W in and pull with a second Q stack.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are hers — she trades around your W cooldown and her shield resets faster than your bulk can punish, so play around cs and don't over-extend without W up. At 6 the lane flips to you for one window: All Out converts you to a duelist and lets you survive her burst combo, so look to W-charge unstoppable through her stun, R through her to peel her dashes away, and duel her down before she back-times into items. Track when her E shield is down — that's your only opening to commit.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are hers — she trades around your W cooldown and her 10s E shield resets faster than your bulk can punish, so play around cs and don't over-extend without W up. At 6 the lane flips to you for one window: All Out converts you to a duelist and lets you survive her burst, so charge W for the damage reduction, R her through a wall away from her dashes, and duel her down before she back-times into items. Track when her E is down — that's your only opening to commit.

edits.before: This is where she reclaims it. Riven's first-item spike with Conqueror out-damages your tank stats, and her three Q dashes plus E let her sidestep your short W wall-smash and R completely, then reset the combo on you. You don't win the straight 1v1 once she has items — your armor stacking does nothing against her flat-AD burst. Shift to teamfighting: use R All Out to peel her off your carries rather than dueling her solo, and let your team punish her once she's committed her dashes onto you.
edits.after: This is where she reclaims it. Riven's first-item spike with Conqueror out-damages your tank stats, and her three Q dashes plus E let her sidestep your short W wall-smash and R completely, then reset the combo on you. Her ultimate is 60s at rank 3 against your 80s, so she gets a Wind Slash cycle you cannot answer. You don't win the straight 1v1 once she has items — armour does nothing against flat-AD burst. Peel her off your carries with All Out instead of duelling her solo.

edits.before: Survive her combo with W's unstoppable damage-reduction charge, then Q3 knock-up and pull her in to flip the trade
edits.after: Survive her combo behind Path Maker's damage-reduction charge, then stun and pull her in to flip the trade

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Riven, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: Chain Q slows on Riven, pull her with the second stack once Ki Burst is down, W the return damage, then peel out or All Out.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.

notes: The packet defect 'never names any of Riven's abilities' is now genuinely addressed — Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Wind Slash all appear where they matter instead of 'her Q/W/E'. Riven is still called 'he/his/him' in tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and report[9]/[12]; report[8].t also says 'his healing fights your grind' when Riven has no heal in her kit at all (Riot's text for her passive, Q, W, E and R contains no healing) — that itemisation line is inherited boilerplate and should be rewritten, but it sits outside a length-safe single-field fix.
